definitions.explanation: A close and friendly relationship between people or groups. Often used for building relationships through organized activities.

examples.japanese: {親睦|しんぼく}を{深|ふか}める
{会社|かいしゃ}の{親睦会|しんぼくかい}に{参加|さんか}した。
スポーツを{通|つう}じて{両国|りょうこく}の{親睦|しんぼく}を{図|はか}る{交流会|こうりゅうかい}が{開|ひら}かれた。
examples.english: An exchange event was held to promote friendship between the two countries through sports.

notes:
USAGE: {親睦|しんぼく} is commonly used in formal or organizational contexts - companies, schools, clubs, and international relations. It emphasizes building or strengthening relationships.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {親睦|しんぼく}を{深|ふか}める (to deepen friendship)
- {親睦|しんぼく}を{図|はか}る (to promote goodwill)
- {親睦会|しんぼくかい} (get-together, social gathering)
- {親睦旅行|しんぼくりょこう} (fellowship trip)
- {親睦|しんぼく}を{育|はぐく}む (to cultivate friendship)

RELATED WORDS:
- {友好|ゆうこう} (friendship - often between nations)
- {交流|こうりゅう} (exchange, interaction)
- {懇親|こんしん} (friendship, intimacy - as in {懇親会|こんしんかい})
